entries.name: A Bad Season Left You Short
entries.summary:
Weather, harvest failure, poor fishing, weak trade, livestock loss, spoiled goods, low demand, or another seasonal setback left your finances worse than expected.

Narrative effects: Your livelihood has made environmental conditions and practical negotiation directly relevant to whether a difficult season becomes survivable.

entries.name: Adult Runaway
entries.summary:
You deliberately left a household, institution, employer, patron, relationship, community, or expected life and have been trying to remain beyond its reach.

Narrative effects: Leaving taught you to plan routes and avoid being easily located without assuming whether you fled a city, estate, ship, academy, village, or somewhere else.

entries.name: Awakened Late
entries.summary:
Magical capability, sensitivity, or recognition emerged only recently, leaving you to understand something in adulthood that others may have learned much earlier.

Narrative effects: Late magical development has forced rapid learning and careful control. This trait does not grant an Arcana or increased mana.

entries.name: Betrothed for Alliance
entries.summary:
A proposed or existing betrothal has value to households, factions, businesses, political interests, or communities beyond the relationship itself.

Narrative effects: You understand that relationships can carry formal expectations and factional consequences. This trait does not determine your feelings toward the arrangement.

entries.name: Broken Betrothal Survivor
entries.summary:
A serious adult betrothal or expected marriage has recently ended, leaving emotional, social, political, financial, or practical consequences behind.

Narrative effects: You have learned how the end of a formal relationship affects both the people involved and the wider network around them.

entries.name: Business Partner Disappeared
entries.summary:
A business partner or financial associate vanished, stopped answering, fled, died without resolution, or otherwise left you with unanswered questions about shared work, money, records, or obligations.

Narrative effects: Their disappearance has taught you to reconstruct events through both people and records rather than relying on one version of what happened.

entries.name: Academy Dropout Adult
entries.summary:
You left an academy, school, magical institution, noble program, or formal education path before completion.

Narrative effects: You know unfinished education can leave sharper edges than completed lessons.

entries.name: Arcane Research Assistant
entries.summary:
You assisted mages, scholars, academy researchers, ritual theorists, enchantment examiners, or magical engineers with controlled study, experiments, notes, and mistakes everyone hoped would stay minor.

Narrative effects: You notice whether a magical theory has been tested, forbidden, or quietly buried.

entries.name: Baker's Assistant
entries.summary:
You work in a bakery or bakehouse preparing dough, tending ovens, measuring ingredients, shaping loaves, cleaning equipment, moving trays, and learning the routines that keep daily production consistent.

Narrative effects: You judge dough by feel as readily as appearance and know how quickly a small mistake in timing or texture can ruin a full batch.

entries.name: Between Trades
entries.summary:
You have already moved between several kinds of honest work without settling permanently into any of them. You may be competent at many ordinary tasks while still lacking the reputation, certification, guild standing, or conviction of someone who chose one profession.

Narrative effects: You quickly ask what a job requires, what it pays, who actually knows how the place works, and how long anyone expects you to stay.

entries.name: Board-and-Work Laborer
entries.summary:
Much of your adult work has been exchanged partly for food, lodging, stable space, clothing, or other necessities rather than clean wages. You know what it means to earn tonight's bed as well as tomorrow's coin.

Narrative effects: You pay attention to what a meal, a roof, a tool, or a place by the fire is actually costing you.

entries.name: Bodyguard's First Charge
entries.summary:
You took your first serious work protecting a person: noble, merchant, priest, child, scholar, performer, witness, or someone whose survival mattered to others.

Narrative effects: You count threats by distance from the person you are protecting.

entries.name: Border Patrol Recruit
entries.summary:
You served with scouts, border guards, patrol riders, watch posts, frontier wardens, or military scouts during early adulthood.

Narrative effects: You watch horizons, smoke, tracks, and who looks too comfortable near a border.

entries.name: Brewer's Assistant
entries.summary:
You work in a brewery, alehouse, winery, distillery, or similar operation preparing ingredients, cleaning vessels, monitoring fermentation, moving casks, and helping judge whether a batch is developing properly.

Narrative effects: You notice fermentation, spoilage, ingredients, and changing batches by smell long before many customers would recognize the difference.

entries.name: Afraid of Magic
entries.summary:
Magic frightened you during childhood. Spells, mana disturbances, strange lights, enchanted objects, magical creatures, or stories about arcane accidents made you uneasy even when others were fascinated.

Narrative effects: You respect magical danger and know enough about common arcane phenomena to recognize some of what once frightened you.

entries.name: Always Building Something
entries.summary:
Scraps of wood, stones, string, broken furniture, boxes, mud, discarded tools, and whatever else you could find became forts, carts, traps, bridges, toys, shelves, or strange contraptions.

Narrative effects: Your instinct around spare material is to imagine what it could become and how the pieces might support one another.

entries.name: Always Trading Something
entries.summary:
Toys, sweets, chores, favors, cards, marbles, scraps, little treasures, and promises all became things you might trade if the deal seemed worthwhile.

Narrative effects: You instinctively compare what each side values rather than assuming worth is identical for everyone.

entries.name: Animal Rescuer
entries.summary:
Injured birds, abandoned kittens, limping dogs, trapped animals, sick livestock, or vulnerable creatures regularly drew your concern. Adults sometimes discovered you had brought another problem home.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable calming ordinary animals and possess modest familiarity with recognizing and tending simple injuries.

entries.name: Asked Too Many Questions
entries.summary:
You interrogated adults about work, relationships, strangers, customs, places, arguments, rules, rumors, and anything else they clearly hoped you would stop asking about.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable obtaining information through persistent conversation and asking the follow-up question other people leave unspoken.

entries.name: Blamed for Bad Luck
entries.summary:
When something went wrong, some people decided you were unlucky, cursed, strange, or somehow responsible. The accusations may have been cruel superstition, nervous joking, or genuine belief.

Narrative effects: You notice how rumors and local beliefs turn coincidence into reputation.

entries.name: Bookish Child
entries.summary:
Books, stories, lessons, and written knowledge held your attention throughout childhood. You read because you wanted to understand more of the world, not merely because an adult told you to study.

Narrative effects: Written knowledge feels familiar and inviting, especially when it explains how people lived, believed, organized themselves, or understood the past.

entries.name: Bullied and Cornered
entries.summary:
Other children repeatedly singled you out, surrounded you, mocked you, threatened you, excluded you, or used numbers and social pressure to make you feel small.

Narrative effects: You recognize exclusion and intimidation quickly and have experience functioning despite the fear of being outnumbered.

entries.name: Academy Corridor Child
entries.summary:
You spent childhood around an academy, school, magical institution, or scholarly complex without necessarily being formally enrolled. Students, tutors, lectures, books, mana demonstrations, and academic rules surrounded you.

Narrative effects: Academic and magical environments feel familiar, but this trait does not establish that you attended Aldercrest or received formal magical training.

entries.name: Apprentice Helper
entries.summary:
You were not yet a true apprentice, but you regularly fetched tools, swept floors, held materials, watched demonstrations, and assisted simple work around a craft.

Narrative effects: Workshop work feels familiar, and you can recognize the difference between rough handling and competent workmanship without yet being a trained artisan.

entries.name: Bakery Child
entries.summary:
Ovens, dough, flour, cooling bread, early mornings, fuel, deliveries, sweet smells, burned crusts, and constant food preparation filled your childhood surroundings.

Narrative effects: Food preparation feels familiar, and you developed a good sense for flavor and the condition of prepared foods.

entries.name: Barefoot Village Child
entries.summary:
Much of your childhood was spent moving freely through a village and its surrounding lanes, fields, paths, gardens, streams, and commons. Shoes were optional more often than adults preferred.

Narrative effects: Village paths and ordinary rural surroundings feel familiar, and you are comfortable moving quickly across ground that is not perfectly prepared.

entries.name: Barge Deck Child
entries.summary:
A barge, riverboat, or working canal vessel was one of the places where you spent most of your childhood days. Cargo, poles, ropes, banks, locks, currents, and routes became familiar.

Narrative effects: You naturally think of rivers and canals as routes and possess modest familiarity with controlling working watercraft.

entries.name: Bathhouse Child
entries.summary:
You spent much of childhood around a public bathhouse, washhouse, communal bathing space, or similar social institution where conversation traveled as readily as steam.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable learning about people through casual conversation and half-overheard public talk.

entries.name: Border Fort Child
entries.summary:
Your childhood social world included walls, gates, patrols, watch towers, soldiers, travelers, warning signals, and people constantly paying attention to who approached.

Narrative effects: You naturally pay attention to approaches, gates, watch behavior, uniforms, and visible changes in a defended place.

entries.name: Archer
entries.summary:
You are extensively trained with bows, including range judgment, draw control, breathing, release timing, target movement, and maintaining accuracy under pressure. Your expertise is marksmanship rather than a guarantee of wilderness experience or military service.

Narrative effects: You estimate range, movement, visibility, and clean shooting lanes almost without thinking, especially when a distant target comes into view.

entries.name: Armored Combatant
entries.summary:
You are trained to remain effective while wearing substantial protective gear. You know how to move, breathe, recover, absorb impacts, manage heat and fatigue, and maintain useful positioning without treating armor as a passive shell.

Narrative effects: You understand how protection changes movement and endurance, and you instinctively conserve effort while using armor to make otherwise dangerous exchanges survivable.

entries.name: Axe Specialist
entries.summary:
You are extensively trained with axes as fighting weapons, from compact hand axes to heavy battlefield axes. You understand chopping angles, hooking motions, committed momentum, guard disruption, and how to keep an axe effective when a fight becomes crowded or brutal.

Narrative effects: You naturally judge chopping lanes, hooking opportunities, and whether a committed strike has room to land without wasting its force.

entries.name: Battlefield Survivor
entries.summary:
You are trained or hardened to keep functioning through the fear, exhaustion, confusion, pain, and prolonged danger of serious combat. Your discipline is less about flashy technique than remaining useful when a fight becomes chaotic or costly.

Narrative effects: When violence becomes frightening or exhausting, you fall back on practiced control: breathe, stay aware, keep moving, and do the next necessary thing.

entries.name: Bludgeon Specialist
entries.summary:
You specialize in maces, hammers, clubs, mauls, flails, and other weapons that defeat resistance through impact rather than a cutting edge. Your training emphasizes weight transfer, breaking guards, controlling recoil, and placing heavy force where it matters most.

Narrative effects: You read armor, shields, doors, joints, and footing in terms of where concentrated impact will have the greatest effect.

entries.name: Agile Frame
entries.summary:
Your natural build strongly favors balance, speed, coordination, and controlled movement. Grants +8 Dexterity.

Narrative effects: You shift your weight before moving, recover quickly from awkward footing, and prefer clean motion over brute effort.

entries.name: Analytical Awareness
entries.summary:
Your mind strongly favors structured reasoning, supported by enough perception to keep conclusions grounded in what is actually happening. Grants +6 Intelligence and +2 Perception.

Narrative effects: You usually lead with memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding, calling on awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues to support that strength when the situation demands it.

entries.name: Articulate Intellect
entries.summary:
You combine memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding with presence, expression, persuasion, and social projection in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Intelligence and +4 Communication.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing memory, structured reasoning, theory, and technical understanding and presence, expression, persuasion, and social projection together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Athletic Balance
entries.summary:
You combine physical power with fluid movement in nearly equal measure, relying on coordinated force rather than either brute strength or agility alone. Grants +4 Strength and +4 Dexterity.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing physical power, leverage, and force and agility, balance, speed, and bodily control together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Balanced Combatant
entries.summary:
You combine close-combat instinct with controlled accuracy in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Fighting and +4 Accuracy.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges and aim, precision, hand control, and exact placement together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Battle Awareness
entries.summary:
You combine close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges with awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Fighting and +4 Perception.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges and awareness, observation, pattern recognition, and subtle cues together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Battle Hardiness
entries.summary:
You combine endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain with close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges in nearly equal measure. Grants +4 Constitution and +4 Fighting.

Narrative effects: You tend to approach difficult situations by bringing endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain and close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges together rather than relying on either aptitude alone.

entries.name: Battle-Hardened
entries.summary:
Your aptitude strongly favors endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain, while close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges provides a meaningful secondary strength. Grants +6 Constitution and +2 Fighting.

Narrative effects: You usually lead with endurance, resilience, recovery, and resistance to strain, calling on close-combat timing, pressure, defense, and weapon exchanges to support that strength when the situation demands it.

entries.name: Adopted Family Name
entries.summary:
You belong to a family whose name, traditions, relationships, and history became yours through adoption rather than biological descent. Whatever ancestry you were born with does not make this family any less real.

Narrative effects: You understand family as something created through belonging, shared life, and mutual recognition as well as blood. This trait never overrides separate facts about biological ancestry established elsewhere.

entries.name: Animal Breeder Line
entries.summary:
Your family repeatedly bred horses, livestock, working animals, hunting animals, or other domesticated stock. Temperament, health, conformation, lineage, useful traits, and market value were judged across generations rather than one animal at a time.

Narrative effects: You are familiar with evaluating animals both as living creatures requiring proper handling and as stock whose quality and suitability can materially differ.

entries.name: Bakers' Line
entries.summary:
Bakers recur through your family history, rising before others, working by touch and timing, managing ovens, stretching ingredients, and feeding people whether the season was prosperous or lean. Recipes and judgments were often learned through hands and repetition rather than written measurements.

Narrative effects: You inherited strong familiarity with prepared foods and with judging dough, texture, moisture, heat, and readiness through practiced touch.

entries.name: Banking and Ledger Family
entries.summary:
Your family became known for lending, accounts, estate management, bookkeeping, financial brokerage, tax work, or trusted handling of other people's money. Generations learned that fortunes can depend on a number copied correctly and a promise recorded clearly.

Narrative effects: You pay attention to accounts, witnesses, missing entries, repayment terms, and the quiet power held by whoever controls the records.

entries.name: Border-Warden Line
entries.summary:
Your family has spent generations guarding borderlands, dangerous roads, isolated passes, watch routes, frontier settlements, or other places where protection arrives slowly. The tradition may involve soldiers, scouts, local wardens, guides, or ordinary people who learned to keep watch because someone had to.

Narrative effects: You instinctively study approaches, weather, warning signs, escape routes, and how long help would actually take to arrive.

entries.name: Brewers' Line
entries.summary:
Brewers, fermenters, cellar workers, or makers of drink and other fermented goods recur through your family history. Clean vessels, ingredients, temperature, smell, timing, storage, and the difference between a promising batch and a spoiled one became familiar family knowledge.

Narrative effects: You recognize many of the smells associated with fermentation, ingredients, spoilage, and stored drink and understand the preparation behind them.

entries.name: Builder's Line
entries.summary:
Carpenters, masons, engineers, architects, bridge builders, millwrights, or other makers of useful structures recur throughout your family. The family tradition values measurements, maintenance, materials, and leaving something standing after the builders are gone.

Narrative effects: You notice load, joinery, foundations, maintenance, bad repairs, and the quiet decisions hidden inside ordinary structures.

entries.name: Alchemist
entries.summary:
You understand alchemical and prepared mixtures: reagents, potions, oils, powders, acids, antidotes, catalysts, biological ingredients, food-and-drink processes, and controlled material reactions. Your knowledge supports preparation and analysis without granting magical Arcana.

Narrative effects: You classify substances by ingredients, preparation, reaction, contamination, dosage, and what natural properties may explain the result.

entries.name: Appraiser
entries.summary:
You specialize in judging the value, quality, authenticity, materials, workmanship, condition, and market worth of physical goods. You can compare craftsmanship and provenance, but Appraisal does not automatically reveal hidden magic, social motives, or facts unrelated to the object being examined.

Narrative effects: You inspect material, workmanship, condition, authenticity, provenance, and likely market demand before deciding what an object is actually worth.

entries.name: Arcana Scholar
entries.summary:
You specialize in Arcana as recognized magical domains: their classifications, affinities, manifestations, known interactions, historical examples, institutional records, and social consequences. This expertise is knowledge of magic and does not itself grant an Arcana or the ability to cast spells.

Narrative effects: When unusual magic is described, you compare the evidence with known Arcana patterns, recorded cases, and the limits of what the witnesses actually observed.

entries.name: Arcane Theorist
entries.summary:
You study the underlying structure of magic: mana behavior, resonance, containment, interference, magical boundaries, spell construction, and theories about why supernatural effects behave as they do. Understanding a magical principle does not mean you can personally perform every effect you understand.

Narrative effects: You look beneath a magical display for structure, resonance, boundaries, sources of instability, and the theory that best explains what actually happened.

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary:
You specialize in finding, comparing, organizing, and reconstructing information from records, maps, correspondence, ledgers, legal documents, journals, testimony, and formal sources. You know how archives hide answers through poor indexing, missing context, contradictory records, and deliberate omission.

Narrative effects: You search records systematically, compare sources, track provenance, note contradictions, and distinguish what a document actually proves from what someone hoped it would prove.

entries.name: Acid Arcana
entries.summary:
You have a natural gift for Acid Arcana: acid, corrosion, caustic liquid, dissolving reactions, chemical burn, etching, and controlled material breakdown. Your magic expresses this theme instinctively, and training turns that instinct into controlled spellwork.

Narrative effects: You notice corrosion, sharp chemical scents, weakened surfaces, and where something has been eaten away.

entries.name: Air Arcana
entries.summary:
You have a natural gift for Air Arcana: wind, pressure, breath, movement, and battlefield disruption. Your magic feels light, sharp, swift, and difficult to pin down.

Narrative effects: You notice drafts, breath, pressure shifts, and the way sound moves through a room.

entries.name: Beast Arcana
entries.summary:
You have a natural gift for Beast Arcana: animal instinct, predatory senses, pack awareness, natural ferocity, and communication with beasts or beast-like forces. It is often instinctive, traditional, or inherited rather than academy-taught.

Narrative effects: You read animals and monsters by posture, breath, hunger, fear, and territorial patience.

entries.name: Arcanum Survey-Bred
entries.summary:
You were shaped by Arcanum's surveyors, expeditions, mapped anomalies, observatories, field reports, and habit of turning strange places into documented knowledge. Divination is part of that outlook, helping practitioners examine traces and hidden qualities that ordinary sight alone may miss.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable turning observation into maps, records, and practical conclusions. Divination Arcana complements that cultural habit of investigation without requiring that you served as an official surveyor.

entries.name: Arcanum Tower-Taught
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the academic face of the Arcanum Ascendancy, where magical theory, controlled study, restricted collections, and ranked access to knowledge carry real social weight. Divination is a characteristic cultural tool for examination, diagnosis, magical survey, and determining what something actually is before anyone interferes with it.

Narrative effects: You approach magical questions through study, evidence, records, and examination. Divination Arcana is a culturally familiar method of inquiry and does not imply mastery of every magical discipline.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Divination Arcana +5, Arcane Lore +8, Archival Research +8

entries.name: Arcanum Wardwise
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the cautious, regulated side of Arcanum life: containment rules, permissions, disciplined experimentation, magical hazards, and the understanding that curiosity without control can become everyone's problem. Divination is commonly valued because identifying a danger correctly is often the first step toward containing it.

Narrative effects: You instinctively think about magical risks, control, permissions, and what must be understood before action is taken. Your Divination Arcana reflects Arcanum's investigative culture rather than a particular profession.

entries.name: Ashen Maw Challenge-Bred
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the Ashen Maw's challenge customs, martial pride, public tests of nerve, and expectation that a person should be able to stand behind their words. Fire magic accompanies that culture of dangerous intensity without making every native cruel or aggressive.

Narrative effects: You are comfortable with direct confrontation and with situations where fear itself becomes part of the contest. Fire Arcana reflects Ashen Maw magical heritage rather than an automatic desire for violence.

entries.name: Ashen Maw Cinderland
entries.summary:
You were shaped by the harsher lands around the Ashen Maw, where fire-touched terrain, dangerous routes, old battlefields, clan territories, and practical readiness make survival a communal concern. Fire magic is woven into the region's identity as naturally as heat, ash, and remembered war.

Narrative effects: You understand Ashen Maw terrain and the practical military habits of communities shaped by dangerous borders. Fire Arcana is culturally learned magic, not a declaration of allegiance or profession.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Fire Arcana +5, Natural Lore +8, Military Lore +8

entries.name: Ashen Maw Oathwise
entries.summary:
You were shaped by Ashen Maw clan law, blood obligations, harsh hospitality, remembered wars, and promises whose social weight may exceed anything written on paper. Fire magic is the culture's most recognizable magical inheritance, tied to fire-touched lands and old demon traditions.

Narrative effects: You understand Ashen Maw obligations and the discipline needed to live under demanding clan expectations. Fire Arcana is culturally familiar magic, not proof of a violent temperament.

entries.name: Abyss Arcana
entries.summary:
You carry a legendary resonance with Abyss Arcana, awakened only through a major story gate, explicit start rule, or manually authored consequence. Abyss Arcana governs bottomless depth, crushing darkness, drowned silence, devouring pressure, fear of the deep, and forces that pull meaning downward until light feels far away. It should feel vast, oppressive, and dangerous to understand.

Narrative effects: You notice deep silence, pressure in darkness, and places where the world feels too thin above something vast.

entries.name: Abyss Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Abyss Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Weight of the Deep.

Narrative effects: Treat Abyss Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Abyss Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Weight of the Deep when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Acid Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Acid Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Selective Dissolution.

Narrative effects: Treat Acid Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Acid Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Selective Dissolution when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Acrobatics Apex
entries.summary:
Your command of acrobatics is exceptional even among seasoned specialists. You combine economy, judgement, and control across balance, tumbling, controlled falls, recovery, and precise body movement under pressure, while still respecting tools, resources, environment, and credible opposition.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an exceptional acrobatics practitioner. Let expertise change what approaches are plausible, but never erase consequences, impossible geometry, unavailable tools, social authority, or established world rules.

entries.name: Acrobatics Discipline
entries.summary:
You have turned acrobatics into a deliberate specialty through repeated practice. You are reliably trained in balance, tumbling, controlled falls, recovery, and precise body movement under pressure, but difficult situations still depend on position, tools, opposition, and judgement.

Narrative effects: Treat acrobatics as a practiced specialization. The character deliberately applies balance, tumbling, controlled falls, recovery, and precise body movement under pressure; give that training weight without granting automatic success or ignoring normal constraints.

entries.name: Acrobatics Expertise
entries.summary:
Your acrobatics remains reliable when conditions become complicated. You can adapt balance, tumbling, controlled falls, recovery, and precise body movement under pressure to pressure, poor timing, difficult terrain, and active opposition instead of relying on ideal circumstances.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an experienced acrobatics specialist who adapts technique under pressure. Preserve normal risk, resource costs, physical limits, law, witnesses, and opposition.

entries.name: Acrobatics Mastery
entries.summary:
Acrobatics has become one of your defining masteries. You recognize advanced openings and methods within balance, tumbling, controlled falls, recovery, and precise body movement under pressure, and this trait grants the signature ability Impossible Recovery.

Narrative effects: Treat acrobatics as a defining mastery. The character may use Impossible Recovery when its fictional setup is plausible; it creates a special option, not guaranteed success or permission to bypass unrelated skills.

entries.name: Adaptive Training
entries.summary:
A broad life of changing roles and unfamiliar customs has made you better at recognizing useful methods without pretending instant mastery. You learn how to fit new practice into what you already understand.

Narrative effects: The character observes before assuming and adapts deliberately to unfamiliar methods and cultures. This does not grant missing skills, languages, authority, Arcana, or professional competence for free.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 20, Cultural Lore skill 35, Self-Discipline skill 35

entries.name: Aegis Arcana
entries.summary:
You carry a legendary resonance with Aegis Arcana, awakened only through a major story gate, explicit start rule, or manually authored consequence. Aegis Arcana governs absolute protection, sacred defense, last stands, guardian force, refusal of harm, and the supernatural boundary between disaster and those who must survive it. It should feel like protection with weight, duty, and consequence rather than effortless invulnerability.

Narrative effects: You notice weak points in protection, who is standing between danger and others, and the exact moment a defense must not fail.

entries.name: Aegis Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Aegis Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Guardian's Refusal.

Narrative effects: Treat Aegis Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Aegis Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Guardian's Refusal when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Air Arcana Mastery
entries.summary:
You have trained Air Arcana beyond simple affinity into a major specialization. Your control is more precise, economical, and reliable inside its established domain, but mastery does not expand what the Arcana governs or remove mana costs, opposition, risk, or story consequences. This mastery grants the signature ability Pressure Shell.

Narrative effects: Treat Air Arcana as a major specialization. Favor deliberate, technically informed expressions of the authored Air Arcana domain; do not reinterpret it as another Arcana, grant effects outside its definition, or waive normal mana, strain, witnesses, and consequences. The character may use Pressure Shell when its fictional setup is plausible; it is a mastery technique, not automatic success or permission to exceed the Arcana domain.

entries.name: Ambush Specialist
entries.summary:
You have deliberately learned to combine Stealth and Thrown Weapons as one working discipline instead of treating them as unrelated skills. The overlap gives you options that depend on both kinds of competence and grants the signature ability Second Angle.

Narrative effects: Treat Ambush Specialist as a genuine hybrid specialization. The character combines Stealth with Thrown Weapons when both materially matter to the approach; do not let either skill substitute for the other or bypass normal tools, authority, resources, evidence, positioning, or consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 10, Stealth skill 30, Thrown Weapons skill 30

entries.name: Arcane Investigator
entries.summary:
You have deliberately learned to combine Arcane Lore and Searching as one working discipline instead of treating them as unrelated skills. The overlap gives you options that depend on both kinds of competence and grants the signature ability Residual Sequence.

Narrative effects: Treat Arcane Investigator as a genuine hybrid specialization. The character combines Arcane Lore with Searching when both materially matter to the approach; do not let either skill substitute for the other or bypass normal tools, authority, resources, evidence, positioning, or consequences.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: characterLevel 10, Arcane Lore skill 30, Searching skill 30

entries.name: Arcane Scholarship Apex
entries.summary:
Your command of arcane scholarship is exceptional even among seasoned specialists. You combine economy, judgement, and control across magical theory, structures, precedents, interactions, and distinguishing what a magical effect is from what it merely resembles, while still respecting tools, resources, environment, and credible opposition.

Narrative effects: Treat the character as an exceptional arcane scholarship practitioner. Let expertise change what approaches are plausible, but never erase consequences, impossible geometry, unavailable tools, social authority, or established world rules.

entries.name: Arcane Scholarship Discipline
entries.summary:
You have turned arcane scholarship into a deliberate specialty through repeated practice. You are reliably trained in magical theory, structures, precedents, interactions, and distinguishing what a magical effect is from what it merely resembles, but difficult situations still depend on position, tools, opposition, and judgement.

Narrative effects: Treat arcane scholarship as a practiced specialization. The character deliberately applies magical theory, structures, precedents, interactions, and distinguishing what a magical effect is from what it merely resembles; give that training weight without granting automatic success or ignoring normal constraints.

entries.name: Arcane Scholarship Expertise

entries.name: Acrobat
entries.summary:
You are highly practiced in tumbling, balance, rolls, careful landings, narrow surfaces, and precise whole-body control. You can move through awkward spaces with confidence without implying a performer, thief, or martial background.

Narrative effects: You instinctively read rails, beams, tables, ledges, and uneven ground as usable movement space.

entries.name: Animal Calmer
entries.summary:
You specialize in handling frightened, agitated, wounded, hostile, overstimulated, or unfamiliar animals. Your approach relies on controlled movement, patience, reading stress, and avoiding actions that make panic worse.

Narrative effects: When an animal becomes difficult, you become quieter and more deliberate rather than trying to overpower its fear.

entries.name: Balance Specialist
entries.summary:
You have trained exceptional balance and body positioning for unstable footing, narrow surfaces, swaying structures, steep ground, and controlled movement at height. Your specialty is staying composed where secure footing cannot be assumed.

Narrative effects: You notice footing, weight distribution, handholds, and the safest line across unstable ground before committing your weight.

entries.name: Beast Handler
entries.summary:
You are highly practiced at calming, directing, training, reading, caring for, and working with animals, mounts, livestock, hunting beasts, and other non-sapient creatures. You understand how fear, discomfort, reward, habit, and trust shape behavior.

Narrative effects: You pay close attention to posture, breathing, ears, eyes, tension, and the small behavioral signs animals give before they react.

entries.name: Academy Foundation Student
entries.summary:
You were expected to complete foundational lessons connected to an academy, magical school, scholarly institution, or formal preparatory program.

Narrative effects: Basic magical theory and formal written study are familiar, but this trait grants neither an Arcana nor automatic later admission to any specific academy.

entries.name: Animal Groom
entries.summary:
You were regularly responsible for brushing, cleaning, checking, feeding, and preparing animals used for riding, work, transport, or household purposes.

Narrative effects: Animal behavior and physical condition are familiar through direct hands-on care.

entries.name: Apothecary Ingredient Sorter
entries.summary:
You sorted dried herbs, powders, oils, roots, fungi, bottles, and other ingredients according to simple instructions in an apothecary or preparation room.

Narrative effects: Preparation ingredients feel familiar, and you learned to distinguish some materials through smell as well as appearance.

entries.name: Baker's Helper
entries.summary:
You helped measure ingredients, knead dough, prepare ovens, move trays, watch timing, and judge whether bread or pastries were developing properly.

Narrative effects: Food preparation and judging flavor or readiness through taste became practical work.

entries.name: Barefoot Errand Runner
entries.summary:
You regularly carried messages, parcels, food, tools, or requests between nearby households and familiar places, often moving quickly and with little ceremony.

Narrative effects: You are accustomed to moving quickly on ordinary errands and understand the local habits that determine where people, goods, and messages belong.

entries.name: Barge Rope Hand
entries.summary:
You regularly handled ropes, cargo lines, tow lines, mooring work, and other physically demanding tasks aboard or beside barges.

Narrative effects: Working around controlled watercraft and handling heavy lines are familiar responsibilities.

entries.name: Border Watch Runner
entries.summary:
You carried messages, food, tools, or warnings between watch posts, gates, patrol points, or nearby households around a defended border settlement.

Narrative effects: Military routines and moving quickly between defensive positions are familiar without implying combat training.

entries.name: Brewer's Helper
entries.summary:
You helped with ingredients, vessels, cleaning, stirring, storage, fermentation, barrels, and tasting batches under adult supervision.

Narrative effects: Preparation and fermentation processes feel familiar, and you developed a practical sense for flavor and faults.

entries.name: Befriended a Strange Beast
entries.summary:
You formed a brief or lasting bond with an animal or unusual non-humanoid creature that others found intimidating, unfamiliar, troublesome, or simply strange.

Narrative effects: You learned to judge a creature through behavior rather than reputation. This trait grants no Beast Arcana.

entries.name: Broke a Friendship
entries.summary:
A friendship that had mattered to you ended through argument, distance, betrayal, jealousy, changing interests, or a choice neither of you could easily undo.

Narrative effects: You learned that relationships can fail without either person becoming a simple villain.

entries.name: Administrator
entries.summary:
You are practiced in administrative work: records, permits, petitions, schedules, appointments, taxes, staffing, institutional correspondence, and the procedures that keep an office or public body functioning. Your expertise is practical rather than a grant of authority; you know how systems are organized and how their paperwork moves.

Narrative effects: When institutions become confusing, you look for the record, responsible office, required signature, deadline, and procedural step that actually controls what happens next.

entries.name: Animal Trainer
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced at training animals, mounts, dogs, birds, work beasts, guard animals, or other manageable creatures through repetition, reward, boundaries, trust, and careful reading of behavior. Training does not make every creature tame or controllable.

Narrative effects: You watch posture, attention, stress, reward response, learned cues, and the relationship between handler and animal before deciding what a creature actually understands.

entries.name: Apothecary
entries.summary:
You are professionally practiced at preparing, storing, labeling, compounding, and dispensing medicines, salves, tinctures, tonics, powders, and other biological or alchemical preparations. You understand ingredients and preparation, but do not assume every product is magical.

Narrative effects: You check labels, dosage, storage, contamination, ingredient quality, interactions, and whether a preparation matches the condition it is actually being used to treat.

entries.name: Baker
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced in breads, doughs, pastries, ovens, fermentation, flour, fats, sweeteners, heat control, batch timing, and producing reliable food at household or commercial scale.

Narrative effects: You judge flour, dough, heat, fermentation, moisture, timing, and oven behavior by touch and habit, and you notice quickly when a batch is going wrong.

entries.name: Blacksmith
entries.summary:
You are professionally trained to forge, shape, repair, and maintain metal tools, fittings, hardware, weapon parts, armor components, nails, hinges, and other practical iron or steel work. Smithing skill represents real forge competence rather than merely knowing metal theory.

Narrative effects: You read metal by heat, color, sound, deformation, wear, and the quality of previous work before deciding whether something should be repaired, reforged, or replaced.

entries.name: Bookkeeper
entries.summary:
You can maintain, audit, and interpret accounts, inventories, debts, taxes, payments, wages, expenses, and financial trails. You are trained to notice inconsistencies between what a ledger claims and what goods, coin, or obligations should actually exist.

Narrative effects: You notice missing coin, repeated corrections, suspicious debts, mismatched inventories, and accounts whose neatness hides something that does not add up.

entries.name: Brewer
entries.summary:
You are professionally experienced in brewing and fermentation for drinks and other prepared consumables. You understand ingredients, cleanliness, temperature, time, vessels, spoilage, flavor, strength, and the careful repetition required for consistent batches.

Narrative effects: You smell and taste cautiously, watch fermentation, inspect vessels, and pay attention to temperature, contamination, and the difference between a developing batch and a ruined one.

entries.name: Badgerfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Badgerfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus badger ears, striped markings, strong hands, heavy shoulders, and a grounded stance. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: Dense shoulders, strong hands, scent awareness, and a low center of gravity favor bracing, lifting, grappling, digging, and sustained exertion. Treat these as physical aptitudes, not a requirement that the character be stubborn or aggressive.

entries.name: Batfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Batfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus bat ears, dark eyes, sharp hearing, and night-adapted posture. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: Exceptional hearing and comfort in darkness make faint movement, echoes, and nearby activity easier to notice and follow. Bright, exposed places may be less comfortable, but do not force fearfulness, nocturnal habits, or a particular personality.

entries.name: Bearfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Bearfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus rounded bear ears, a dense build, broad shoulders, thick hair, and heavy movement. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: A dense build, heavy strength, durable frame, and strong scent sense favor lifting, carrying, resisting physical strain, and noticing nearby traces. Size may affect first impressions but does not dictate temperament.

entries.name: Boarkin Beastkin
entries.summary:
Boarkin Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus boar ears, small tusks or tusk-like teeth, coarse hair, powerful shoulders, and a grounded stance. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: Powerful shoulders, strong endurance, grounded posture, and keen scent favor hard physical effort and bodily leverage. Do not treat boarkin ancestry as automatic aggression, recklessness, or combat training.

entries.name: Bullfolk Beastkin
entries.summary:
Bullfolk Beastkin are kemonomimi-style beastkin with fully humanlike faces and bodies plus bull horns, bovine ears, a tail, broad build, thick neck, and heavy presence. They are not animal-headed, muzzled, furry-bodied, paw-handed, digitigrade animal-bodied, or full anthropomorphic animals.

Narrative effects: A broad frame, thick neck, horns, and heavy presence make raw force and physical pressure especially convincing. Their imposing appearance can affect first impressions without forcing a domineering personality.

entries.name: Advocate
entries.summary:
You are skilled at arguing for a person, cause, proposal, petition, defense, or position before people whose approval matters. You combine persuasive presentation with an understanding of the audience, interests, objections, and social context surrounding the decision.

Narrative effects: Before making your case, you ask who actually needs convincing and what objection is most likely to stop them.

entries.name: Attentive Courter
entries.summary:
You are practiced at expressing romantic interest through attention, warmth, responsiveness, and awareness of another person's comfort and reactions. This improves your ability to court someone who may be receptive; it never creates attraction, bypasses consent, or establishes a relationship by itself.

Narrative effects: You pay close attention to whether interest is being returned, welcomed, redirected, or quietly declined.

entries.name: Academy Uniform Set
entries.summary: A formal student uniform from an academy, tutor house, or magical institution. It carries the trace of structured lessons, rival students, and institutional expectations.

entries.name: Artisan's Workwear Set
entries.summary: Practical workshop clothing suited for tools, dust, splinters, stains, and long hours of making or repairing things with the hands.

entries.name: Breastplate Set
entries.summary: A shaped metal breastplate with supporting straps and fittings, protecting the torso while leaving the wearer more mobile than full heavy armor.

entries.name: Arbalest
entries.summary: A heavy winched crossbow with punishing force, slow reload, and terrifying performance against armor at prepared range.

entries.name: Bardiche
entries.summary: Starting weapon for Polearms. A broad axe-bladed polearm that bites hard into s.

entries.name: Bastard Sword
entries.summary: A hand-and-a-half sword that bridges agile one-handed cuts and stronger two-handed leverage.

entries.name: Battle Axe
entries.summary: A martial axe designed to split shields, hook defenses, and deliver brutal chopping force. It has none of a court blade's elegance and all of a battlefield's honesty.

entries.name: Battle Staff
entries.summary: A reinforced fighting staff made for battlefield pressure, guards, sweeps, and armored strikes.

entries.name: Bearded Axe
entries.summary: A hooked axe with a lowered blade edge, useful for cuts, pulls, shield work, and close control.

entries.name: Billhook
entries.summary: A hooked pole weapon adapted from forestry tools, useful for pulling shields, catching limbs, and dragging riders down.

entries.name: Bo Staff
entries.summary: A long balanced staff focused on reach, rhythm, and clean strikes without exceeding heavier reinforced staves.

entries.name: Boar Spear
entries.summary: A sturdy hunting spear with lugs to stop a charging beast from driving up the shaft.

entries.name: Buckler Shield
entries.summary: A small hand shield suited for duelists, scouts, light fighters, and anyone who wants defense without giving up too much speed.

entries.name: Apprenticeship Became a Dead End
entries.summary:
You remained in an apprenticeship long enough to realize that it was teaching too little, offering no advancement, exploiting your labor, or leading toward a life you no longer wanted.

Narrative effects: You learned to recognize when an institution's promises and actual opportunities no longer match.

entries.name: Became Someone's Caregiver
entries.summary:
Illness, injury, disability, age, or difficult circumstances meant another person began depending on you for regular practical care.

Narrative effects: Caregiving gave you practical medical familiarity and taught you to notice another person's needs consistently.

entries.name: Best Friend Left
entries.summary:
Your closest friend moved away, joined another life, entered service, traveled, married, disappeared from your daily world, or otherwise ceased being part of your ordinary routine.

Narrative effects: Separation taught you that relationships can matter deeply without remaining permanently present.

entries.name: Broke With a Mentor
entries.summary:
A teacher, master, senior colleague, guardian, patron, or other mentor who had once guided you became someone you could no longer follow.

Narrative effects: The break taught you to understand disagreement with someone you respected and to articulate a direction of your own.

entries.name: Broke a Serious Oath
entries.summary:
You broke a promise or oath that you had once considered serious, whether through choice, necessity, failure, or changing convictions.

Narrative effects: You understand both the discipline required to keep commitments and the human consequences when they are broken.

entries.name: Broken Betrothal
entries.summary:
A planned or expected betrothal ended before marriage through refusal, family decision, scandal, politics, incompatibility, or circumstances beyond either person's control.

Narrative effects: You understand both the emotional and formal social consequences that can surround arranged or expected relationships.

entries.name: Academy Student
entries.summary:
Your teenage years were shaped by formal study at an academy, college, temple school, noble institute, or another structured place of learning. Lessons, assignments, records, examinations, and long hours of study formed the center of your path.

Narrative effects: Formal education and sustained academic work are familiar. This path does not imply magical education unless another part of the character establishes it.

entries.name: Animal Trainer's Apprentice
entries.summary:
You trained under someone who deliberately taught animals commands, behaviors, routines, tricks, work patterns, or responses rather than merely caring for them.

Narrative effects: You developed substantial animal-training skill supported by practical understanding of animal behavior and natural needs.

entries.name: Apprentice Alchemist
entries.summary:
You trained under an alchemist, brewer, potion-maker, compounder, or similar practitioner and spent years preparing ingredients, following recipes, observing reactions, and learning safe handling.

Narrative effects: Compound preparation became a genuine trained skill supported by knowledge of natural ingredients.

entries.name: Apprentice Carpenter
entries.summary:
You entered serious carpentry training, learning measurement, joining, shaping, repair, tool care, structural judgment, and the practical behavior of wood.

Narrative effects: Woodworking became a substantial craft foundation accompanied by practical understanding of structures and construction.

entries.name: Apprentice Scribe
entries.summary:
You trained to produce clear documents, copies, correspondence, records, labels, and formal script under someone who cared deeply about accuracy.

Narrative effects: Precise handwriting became a professional-level foundation supported by broader written composition.

entries.name: Apprentice Smith
entries.summary:
You spent years learning forge work through heat, metal, tools, fuel, repeated hammering, basic shaping, repairs, and the patient preparation needed before skilled work becomes possible.

Narrative effects: Smithing became a genuine trained trade. Using forge hammers did not automatically teach you combat with bludgeoning weapons.

entries.name: Apprentice Tailor
entries.summary:
You trained in measuring, cutting, fitting, stitching, repairing, and judging cloth or garments under an experienced tailor or textile worker.

Narrative effects: Textile work became a serious practical skill, and you developed a good eye for material quality and workmanship.

entries.name: Arcane Theory Obsession
entries.summary:
You spent much of adolescence studying how magic worked: classifications, principles, magical phenomena, historical theories, competing schools of thought, and anything else that promised a deeper explanation.

Narrative effects: You developed unusually deep theoretical magical knowledge through sustained study. This represents scholarship rather than automatic talent with any particular Arcana.

entries.name: Baker's Apprentice
entries.summary:
You spent years learning dough, ovens, timing, ingredients, temperature, consistency, preparation, and the routines needed to produce food reliably every day.

Narrative effects: Food preparation became a trained craft, supported by a practiced ability to judge flavor and readiness.

entries.name: Beast Handler's Assistant
entries.summary:
You spent your teenage years assisting someone who trained, bred, transported, worked with, or cared for animals. Feeding, calming, grooming, exercising, and controlling them became routine.

Narrative effects: You developed substantial practical confidence around animals and useful experience controlling mounts.

entries.name: Black Market Errand Runner
entries.summary:
You carried messages, payments, goods, or introductions through illegal or semi-legal markets where knowing who could be trusted mattered as much as knowing the price.

Narrative effects: You became familiar with illicit commerce and the negotiation habits surrounding goods that cannot simply be sold openly.

entries.name: Brewer's Apprentice
entries.summary:
You trained in brewing, fermentation, storage, sanitation, ingredients, timing, and the judgment needed to tell whether a batch was developing properly.

Narrative effects: Brewing became a serious practical skill, and repeated sampling developed a strong sense for flavor and faults.

entries.name: Abandoned Infant
entries.summary:
You were abandoned before you could understand what abandonment meant. Whether left in a basket, wrapped in scraps, hidden from danger, or discarded by people who could not keep you, your earliest story begins with absence.

Narrative effects: You react strongly to being left behind, even when you try to hide it.

entries.name: Academy Nursery
entries.summary:
You were raised around tutors, students, lesson bells, restricted halls, old books, magical demonstrations, or institutional care connected to an academy.

Narrative effects: You associate learning with rules, tests, careful supervision, and locked doors.

entries.name: Barely Kept Alive
entries.summary:
Your earliest years were harsh: too little food, too little warmth, too few hands, or too many dangers. You survived a beginning that could easily have ended before memory formed.

Narrative effects: You waste very little and notice when food, warmth, or care is taken for granted.

entries.name: Beloved Child
entries.summary:
You were loved openly as a toddler. Someone delighted in your first steps, worried over your tears, and made you feel that your existence brought joy rather than burden.

Narrative effects: You find it natural to expect warmth from people, even when the world argues otherwise.

entries.name: Born Aboard Ship
entries.summary:
You were born aboard a vessel or spent your earliest infancy at sea or on major waterways. Deck noise, movement, cramped quarters, bells, shouted orders, and the changing rhythm of a vessel surrounded your beginning.

Narrative effects: The sounds and motion of working vessels feel unusually familiar, even if later professional seamanship still requires actual training.

entries.name: Born During Harvest
entries.summary:
You were born during harvest or spent your first season amid the intense work of bringing in crops, processing food, storing supplies, and preparing a community for the months ahead.

Narrative effects: Seasonal agricultural rhythms and the communal customs surrounding harvest feel deeply familiar.

entries.name: Born During Winter Lock-In
entries.summary:
Your earliest months were spent through a period when snow, ice, storms, closed passes, or severe weather kept the household largely confined. Indoor routines and attention to outside conditions shaped the season.

Narrative effects: You are accustomed to prolonged bad weather and to noticing changes outside through sound when movement and visibility are limited.

entries.name: Born Under Bad Omen
entries.summary:
Storm, eclipse, death, strange birthmark, failed harvest, monster cry, or local superstition made people whisper that your early life carried a bad omen. Whether true or not, belief shaped how some saw you.

Narrative effects: You notice when people turn coincidence into accusation.

entries.name: Born Under Lucky Star
entries.summary:
People believed your earliest life was touched by luck: a favorable sign, lucky birth, strange survival, blessing, good harvest, or an old saying repeated whenever you avoided harm.

Narrative effects: You half-believe fortune favors you, though you rarely say it aloud.

entries.name: Born Under Restriction
entries.summary:
You were born into circumstances where law, debt, institutional authority, occupation, or household status sharply restricted your family's movement, choices, work, or residence from the beginning.

Narrative effects: Your earliest environment taught careful control of outward reactions and close attention to supervision and routine. This trait establishes early circumstance rather than your present legal or social status.

entries.name: Born on the Road
entries.summary:
You were born during a journey or spent your earliest period in a household moving primarily by road. Wagons, carts, roadside stops, animals, camps, and departure were part of the stories surrounding your beginning.

Narrative effects: Road travel feels familiar at a deep level, especially the practical relationship between routes, vehicles, stopping places, and distance.

entries.name: Afraid of Thunder
entries.summary:
Thunder frightened you badly as a toddler, sending you under blankets, into someone's arms, or behind whatever shelter you could find. You may have outgrown the fear, but storms still carry an old emotional weight.

Narrative effects: Sudden loud sounds command your attention, and you have experience acting despite an instinctive startle response.

entries.name: Banged on Pots
entries.summary:
Pots, spoons, tables, boxes, cups, walls, and anything capable of producing a satisfying sound became an improvised instrument.

Narrative effects: You have an instinct for producing rhythm and judging how different surfaces respond to impact.

entries.name: Bit Anyone Too Close
entries.summary:
You were a fierce toddler who bit, kicked, scratched, or shoved when overwhelmed. Adults may have called you difficult, but your first defense was simple: no one got too close without permission.

Narrative effects: Being cornered or handled against your wishes still brings out a sharp defensive streak.

entries.name: Bold With Strangers
entries.summary:
You approached unfamiliar adults and children with startling confidence, asked for things directly, and behaved as though introductions were merely formalities everyone else worried about.

Narrative effects: You rarely need much encouragement before approaching someone unfamiliar and beginning a conversation.

entries.name: Built Little Towers
entries.summary:
Blocks, stones, dishes, scraps, pieces of wood, and other stackable objects repeatedly became towers, walls, bridges, and unstable little structures.

Narrative effects: You enjoy understanding objects through physical arrangement, balance, fit, and direct manipulation.

entries.name: Arcane Concentration
entries.summary:
You trained the mental habits used around magical study and spell control: focus, composure, theoretical awareness, and maintaining intent under pressure. This training does not grant an Arcana or magical power by itself. Grants +2 Willpower and +1 Accuracy.

Narrative effects: Around magic, you focus on maintaining deliberate intent and controlled execution rather than letting surprise, fear, or excitement break concentration.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Self-Discipline +8, Arcane Lore +5, Courage +3, Willpower +2, Accuracy +1

entries.name: Arcane Studies
entries.summary:
You studied magical theory, arcane classification, relics, recorded phenomena, and the language scholars use to discuss magic. This training teaches knowledge, not automatic magical access. Grants +2 Intelligence and +1 Perception.

Narrative effects: When magic appears, you look for structure, signatures, known categories, and evidence before deciding what the phenomenon actually is.

facts.label: Modifiers
facts.value: Arcane Lore +8, Relic Lore +5, Writing +3, Intelligence +2, Perception +1

entries.name: Balance and Footwork
entries.summary:
You deliberately trained stable movement across narrow, uneven, shifting, or elevated ground. The discipline emphasizes placement and recovery rather than speed alone. Grants +2 Dexterity and +1 Strength.

Narrative effects: You test footing without thinking, keep your center of gravity controlled, and recover quickly when the ground or your own movement shifts unexpectedly.

entries.name: Apothecary Household
entries.summary:
You grew up among ingredients, dried plants, compounds, bottles, measurements, preparations, storage rules, strong odors, customers, and substances whose usefulness depended heavily on correct handling.

Narrative effects: You have practical familiarity with biological preparations and are practiced at distinguishing substances and changes through smell.

entries.name: Arcane Academy Ward
entries.summary:
You were raised under the shadow of an arcane institution, academy, mage household, or magical wardship. Mana, tutors, theory, tests, rival students, restricted rooms, and institutional rules were familiar parts of childhood.

Narrative effects: You understand basic magical theory and institutional discipline without this trait granting an Arcana, magical mastery, or automatic academy membership in adulthood.

entries.name: Artisan Family
entries.summary:
You were raised among tools, workshops, craft pride, materials, customers, apprentices, deadlines, repairs, and finished goods. Making useful things shaped how the household judged labor and value.

Narrative effects: You possess broad familiarity with practical fabrication and are accustomed to judging materials, workmanship, repairs, and quality.

entries.name: Bakery Household
entries.summary:
You were raised around ovens, flour, dough, fuel, food preparation, early mornings, regular customers, storage, and the discipline required to produce fresh food on a dependable schedule.

Narrative effects: You have practical familiarity with food preparation and with maintaining repetitive work schedules where poor timing ruins the result.

entries.name: Beastkin Clan
entries.summary:
You were raised in a community where one or more Beastkin peoples formed much of the local social fabric. Kinship, customs, household structures, traditions, local expectations, and relationships with neighboring peoples shaped your upbringing, regardless of your own ancestry.

Narrative effects: You understand the specific community that raised you without treating Beastkin ancestry as a single personality, profession, instinct, or universal culture.

entries.name: Border Fort
entries.summary:
You grew up around a fort, border watch, garrison village, or military outpost. Patrols, gates, alarms, watch schedules, supply stores, strangers on the road, and the possibility of attack shaped your idea of normal life.

Narrative effects: You understand defensive routines and habitually pay attention to approaches, movement, watch points, and visible signs of trouble.

entries.name: Brewery Household
entries.summary:
You were raised around brewing vessels, fermentation, grain, fruit, herbs, barrels, storage, batches, customers, and the constant distinction between something developing properly and something going wrong.

Narrative effects: You understand basic preparation processes and are practiced at distinguishing ingredients, quality, and faults through taste.
